# Introduction

# DATA Wrangling


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)

# Import original data
listings <- read.csv("https://ajohns24.github.io/data/NYC_airbnb_kaggle.csv")
nbhd     <- read.csv("https://ajohns24.github.io/data/NYC_nbhd_kaggle.csv")

# Wrangle this into the final airbnb data
set.seed(253)
airbnb <- listings %>% 
  filter(price > 0, price < 1000) %>% 
  sample_n(size = 5000) %>% 
  rename(neighbourhood = neighbourhood_cleansed) %>% 
  left_join(nbhd) %>% 
  select(-neighbourhood, -amenities, -host_response_rate, -calendar_updated)
```

```{r}
# Create wrangling recipe
airbnb_recipe <- recipe(price ~ ., data = airbnb) %>% 
  step_rm(
    latitude, longitude, host_response_time, host_is_superhost, 
    host_has_profile_pic, is_location_exact, review_scores_rating, 
    cancellation_policy, require_guest_profile_picture, reviews_per_month
  ) %>% 
  step_string2factor(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_knn(all_predictors(), neighbors = 5) 
```


```{r}
# Train the recipe on the data and view head
airbnb_baked <- airbnb_recipe %>% 
  prep() %>% 
  bake(new_data = NULL)

head(airbnb_baked)
```

> This is where we place the plots.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)

set.seed(253)

# This removes columns with zero variance to keep the LASSO math engine stable
airbnb_recipe_model <- recipe(price ~ ., data = airbnb) %>% 
  step_rm(id) %>% 
  step_string2factor(all_nominal_predictors()) %>% 
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>% 
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>% 
  step_impute_knn(all_predictors(), neighbors = 5)


# Cross Validation Folds
airbnb_folds <- vfold_cv(airbnb, v = 10)
```

```{r}
# LS regression model
lm_spec <- linear_reg() %>% 
  set_engine("lm") %>% 
  set_mode("regression")

lm_workflow <- workflow() %>% 
  add_recipe(airbnb_recipe_model) %>% 
  add_model(lm_spec)

lm_cv_results <- fit_resamples(
  lm_workflow,
  resamples = airbnb_folds,
  metrics = metric_set(mae, rmse, rsq)
)

print("LS metrics")
print(collect_metrics(lm_cv_results))

```


```{r}
# Penalized lasso regression
lasso_spec <- linear_reg(penalty = tune(), mixture = 1) %>% 
  set_engine("glmnet") %>% 
  set_mode("regression")

lasso_workflow <- workflow() %>% 
  add_recipe(airbnb_recipe_model) %>% 
  add_model(lasso_spec)

lasso_grid <- grid_regular(penalty(range = c(-3, 1)), levels = 50)

lasso_tune_results <- tune_grid(
  lasso_workflow,
  resamples = airbnb_folds,
  grid = lasso_grid,
  metrics = metric_set(mae, rmse)
)


print("LASSO metrics")
print(show_best(lasso_tune_results, metric = "mae", n = 5))

```
```{r}
# To see which predictors remain
best_lasso_fit <- lasso_workflow %>% 
  finalize_workflow(select_best(lasso_tune_results, metric = "mae")) %>% 
  fit(data = airbnb)

best_lasso_fit %>% 
  extract_fit_engine() %>% 
  tidy() %>% 
  filter(step == max(step))
```
